selectedProject.name: Sentra OS
selectedProject.summary: Extract the Sentra operating layer into its own repo/system with projects, decisions, reviews, priorities, ledger, and promotion inputs.
selectedProject.nextAction: Define portable Sentra folder structure and generator contracts.

objective: Extract the reusable Sentra operating layer from Hermes Mastra Lab into a portable Sentra OS structure.
thesis: Sentra should become the operating context layer that selects, plans, reviews, and updates work before Hermes promotes decisions.

milestones.title: Define Sentra contracts
milestones.outcome: Document the canonical shapes for projects, decisions, reviews, priorities, snapshots, ledgers, and promotion inputs.

milestones.title: Extract portable generators
milestones.outcome: Move Sentra context, review, ledger, priority rewrite, and project prioritization generators behind stable script contracts.

milestones.title: Create operating loop command
milestones.outcome: Provide one command that runs context generation, promotion input generation, ledger report, weekly review, and priority proposal.

milestones.title: Gate extraction readiness
milestones.outcome: Verify the Sentra OS extraction is reversible, artifact-backed, and does not leak Hermes-specific runtime logic.

dependencies.summary: Hermes Mastra Lab has working context, promotion, ledger, review, priority rewrite, and project prioritization flows.
Sentra OS must not absorb Hermes promotion logic or Mastra runtime-specific orchestration details.
Extraction should add schemas or contract docs before moving logic across repos.

risks.mitigation: Extract contracts and generators first; defer app/UI/runtime expansion.
Keep Hermes-specific promotion logic in Hermes and Sentra context logic in Sentra.
Keep Sentra plain TypeScript and artifact-first unless a runtime proves necessary.

successCriteria: Sentra OS can generate snapshot and promotion input from its own project/decision/review/priority files.
Hermes can consume Sentra OS output without knowing Sentra internals.
The extraction has contract docs or schemas.
The operating loop remains reproducible with npm scripts.
No Mastra-specific logic is required inside Sentra OS.
nextAction: Add Sentra contracts and schemas before creating or extracting a separate Sentra OS repo.
notes: This translates multi-project prioritization into an extraction plan.
It does not create the Sentra OS repo yet.
The next push should define Sentra contracts and schemas.
